name: application-multi-step-progress
title: Multi-Step Form Progress
description: Progress headers for paged forms — a numbered step rail with connector lines or a percentage bar with a compact step counter.
useWhen: Progress headers for paged forms — a numbered step rail with connector lines or a percentage bar with a compact step counter.
avoidWhen: Avoid multi-step form progress when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Multi-Step Form Progress uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
